THE AURELLO RANGE

THREE WAYS TO SPRITZ

One recipe, three moods. Each is built on the same bittersweet aperitivo base, then pulled in a different direction by the peel it is pressed with.

Orange Spritz

Sicilian blood orange, gentian root, a long bitter finish.

WHAT IS INSIDE

THREE THINGS, DONE PROPERLY

There is no long ingredient list to hide behind. Everything in the can earns its place, and anything that did not make the drink brighter was taken back out.

Sun-Bright Citrus

Peel pressed from Sicilian blood orange and Amalfi lemon, cold-extracted so the oils stay sharp instead of turning candied.

Aromatic Botanicals

Gentian root and rhubarb for the bitter spine, a little pink peppercorn for lift. Macerated slowly, never rushed with heat.

Fine Bubbles

Carbonated cold and fine, so the first crack fizzes bright and the last mouthful still has something to say.

HOW TO SERVE

GOOD TO GO IN THREE.

01

Chill

Four hours in the fridge, or twenty minutes buried in ice. Cold is not optional here, it is the whole recipe.

02

Crack

Open it flat, listen for the hiss. That sound is the bubbles arriving exactly as they were packed.

03

Pour

Big glass, plenty of ice, a wide slice of orange down the side. Then leave the kitchen and go and sit outside.

OUR STORY

THE SPARK OF TOGETHER

Aurello started at a borrowed table on a borrowed terrace, in that hour where the light goes orange and nobody wants to be the first to leave. The drinks took too long to make, so someone always missed the good part while they were inside stirring.

So we built the whole hour into a can: the bitterness, the citrus oil, the bubbles, the reason to stay. Everything you would have made yourself, if you had not been busy pouring for everybody else.

GOOD QUESTIONS

YOUR QUESTIONS

Everything people ask us before the first can, answered plainly. Anything else, the team reads every message.

How should I serve it?

Very cold, over plenty of ice, in a glass bigger than you think you need. A wide slice of orange down the inside of the glass is the only garnish it wants.

How much alcohol is in a can?

Between 4.5% and 5% ABV depending on the flavour, which is roughly one standard aperitivo serve. Every can prints its exact strength on the base.

Is it really ready to drink?

Completely. Nothing to mix, top up, or stir. Chill it, crack it, pour it over ice, and that is the entire method.

Are the cans recyclable?

Yes. The can and the ring are aluminium and endlessly recyclable, and the outer packs are uncoated board with no plastic wrap.
